capabilities: Publish single or multiple notes to a configured GitHub repository via a pull request
Convert wikilinks to markdown links and update links according to settings
Render Dataview queries, Mermaid and LaTeX during conversion
Clean the repository by removing depublished and deleted files
Test the GitHub connection and check API rate limits
disambiguation: Not limited to MkDocs despite the plugin id; it supports any site template such as Jekyll, MkDocs, Hugo or custom ones.
extras: README warns against using the plugin to sync or back up the vault; full setup and command references are in external documentation rather than the README; the author accepts donations.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in free way to publish notes to a self-hosted or static-site workflow on a GitHub repository.

relations.evidence: Publish your notes in your own GitHub repository for free and do whatever you want with them.
